Name: Tricky Plush
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][i][center][color=#fff2cc]Now you can carry DA CLOWN in your pocket all the time![/color][/center][/i]

[center]Makes vanilla "Ancient Doll" artifact item ( or the "Futan Bear" furniture item if you use alternative version) look like [b][url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8EyCBxsIF5U]Tricky Plushe[/url][/b] from [b]Madness Combat[/b] series. [/center]


You can buy the plushe [url=http://www.makeship.com/products/tricky-the-clown-plush]here on Makeship[/url] (Isn't it freaking amazing!?)
Also, please consider checking [url=http://www.youtube.com/c/KrinkelsNG]Madness Combat series[/url] made by the marvelous man Krinkels.

[s]
[/s][/size]

















ps: please don't put him in a jar...
